program.lowered_gooo_source:
package gooo_workspace
namespace gooo_workspace

entity Report id "gooo://tools/report/v1" fields {
    field state id "gooo://tools/report/state" type string required one
    field next_operation id "gooo://tools/report/next-operation" type string required one
    field message id "gooo://tools/report/message" type string required one
}
entity Text id "gooo://tools/report/text"
entity AssemblyObservation id "gooo://domain-tools/assembly-observation" fields {
    field matched id "gooo://domain-tools/assembly/matched" type integer required one
    field total id "gooo://domain-tools/assembly/total" type integer required one
    field scored id "gooo://domain-tools/assembly/scored" type integer required one
    field budget id "gooo://domain-tools/assembly/budget" type integer required one
}
activity GoooPackage0ActivityAssess(AssemblyObservation) -> Report computes "if input.matched < 0 || input.total < 0 || input.matched > input.total || input.scored < 0 || input.budget < input.scored {\n    return Report{state: \"FAIL_CLOSED\", next_operation: \"RECONCILE_COUNTS\", message: \"관측 수치를 확인하세요.\"}\n}\nif input.total == 0 {\n    return Report{state: \"UNKNOWN\", next_operation: \"DECLARE_CASES\", message: \"판단할 사례를 선언하세요.\"}\n}\nif input.scored == 0 {\n    return Report{state: \"UNKNOWN\", next_operation: \"EVALUATE_CANDIDATES\", message: \"후보를 채점하세요.\"}\n}\nif input.matched == input.total {\n    return Report{state: \"PASS\", next_operation: \"OBSERVE_NEW_INPUTS\", message: \"선언한 사례가 일치합니다.\"}\n}\nif input.scored == input.budget {\n    return Report{state: \"PROGRESS\", next_operation: \"EXPAND_CHOICES\", message: \"선택지를 확장하세요.\"}\n}\nlet result = Report{state: \"\", next_operation: \"\", message: \"\"}\nresult.state = \"PASS\"\nresult.next_operation = \"STOP\"\nresult.message = \"모든 사례를 만족했습니다.\"\nreturn result" assembling {
    choice "partial-state" field_update at "0" alternative "\"PROGRESS\"" intent "부분 충족 상태를 기록한다. Use PROGRESS for incomplete cases."
    choice "continue" field_update at "1" alternative "\"CONTINUE_CANDIDATES\"" intent "남은 예산으로 다른 후보를 시도한다. Continue candidates with remaining budget."
    choice "explanation" field_update at "2" alternative "\"만족하지 못한 사례가 남았습니다.\"" intent "미충족 사례를 설명한다. Explain that unmatched cases remain."
    value_case "[{\"budget\":3,\"matched\":0,\"scored\":1,\"total\":2}]" -> "{\"message\":\"만족하지 못한 사례가 남았습니다.\",\"next_operation\":\"CONTINUE_CANDIDATES\",\"state\":\"PROGRESS\"}"
    value_case "[{\"budget\":3,\"matched\":2,\"scored\":1,\"total\":2}]" -> "{\"message\":\"선언한 사례가 일치합니다.\",\"next_operation\":\"OBSERVE_NEW_INPUTS\",\"state\":\"PASS\"}"
    value_case "[{\"budget\":3,\"matched\":0,\"scored\":0,\"total\":0}]" -> "{\"message\":\"판단할 사례를 선언하세요.\",\"next_operation\":\"DECLARE_CASES\",\"state\":\"UNKNOWN\"}"
    attempts "8"
}
activity GoooPackage1ActivityRender(Report) -> Text computes "return input.state + \" | \" + input.next_operation + \" | \" + input.message"
bind GoooPackage0ActivityAssess.result -> GoooPackage1ActivityRender.input
program.scope: explicitly bound workspace activity bodies lowered to one typed Gooo graph; execution requires finite cases and native Go compilation

choices.intent: 부분 충족 상태를 기록한다. Use PROGRESS for incomplete cases.
남은 예산으로 다른 후보를 시도한다. Continue candidates with remaining budget.
미충족 사례를 설명한다. Explain that unmatched cases remain.
